definitions: Add salt, pepper, or other spices to (food) to improve the flavour.
Make (wood) suitable for use as timber by drying it out over a period.
Make (something) more interesting or enjoyable by adding an element of a different kind.
Accustom (someone) to a particular climate or environment.
examples: Season the soup with salt and pepper.
The timber needs to season for several months.
He seasoned his speech with witty anecdotes.
The travellers were seasoned to the harsh desert conditions.
